verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's developer docs mention a generic account-export endpoint (mailchimp-docs-16) but give no detail on format (CSV/open), or whether tags, engagement history, and suppression lists are all included — the core of the story is only thinly evidenced. Community reports directly contradict the 'self-serve' guarantee: users describe accounts being banned/deleted with lists wiped and no self-serve export path, only receiving a data dump after escalating publicly (mailchimp-comm-1, mailchimp-comm-2), showing the export mechanism can fail exactly when a founder needs it most. missing for 10: documentation of export format/openness, explicit inclusion of custom fields/tags/engagement/suppression list, and independent confirmation that self-serve export reliably works without support intervention.
